# Design 4.2 row 24: cargo-raze, told by its fetch macro. Bazel builds the
# generated `crates.bzl`, never `Cargo.lock`.

=== .bazelversion
6.6.0
=== WORKSPACE
workspace(name = "app")

load("//cargo:crates.bzl", "raze_fetch_remote_crates")

raze_fetch_remote_crates()
=== cargo/crates.bzl
def raze_fetch_remote_crates():
    pass
=== cargo/Cargo.toml
[package]
name = "deps"
version = "0.0.0"

[package.metadata.raze]
workspace_path = "//cargo"
=== cargo/Cargo.lock
version = 3
